newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on routine payments.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on routine payments.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Tuesday as routine early-month payments mopped up market liquidity to reverse the rates' recent slide, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.859 percent against Monday's 4.524 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.80-4.95 against 4.75-5.80. Dealers expected the rates to test the 5.00 level on Wednesday.
The bond market saw no transaction in the afternoon. The 15-year (0442) construction bond yield was at 5.9975-6.0025 and the 10-year 86/2 bond yield at 5.7100 after morning trade.
